digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center outbound comment/description sanitization and convergence tests
propositions: DC lacks the comment and description length convergence suites that Cloud has, so oversized outbound text is not verified to converge on a second plan pass.
DC's sanitize_comment binds comments to the description limit (WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT=32767) and reuses the description fitter fit_outbound, coupling comment truncation to description behavior.

32767 is verified as the correct DC comment ceiling for stock Jira >=7.0 because jira.text.field.character.limit governs Description, Environment, Comments and Text custom fields with one default value (per jpm.xml and JRASERVER-28519).

The DC comment limit is admin-configurable (0 to 2147483647) but rebar hardcodes the 32767 default, so on instances with a raised or unlimited setting rebar truncates comments Jira would accept, causing data loss.

The constant WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT and its comment in rich_text.py assert a false Cloud-comment provenance, reversing the actual causality where DC's number derives from jira.text.field.character.limit.
Convergence must be asserted as a two-pass property where the second pass plans no change, and the truncation suffix marker must survive the round trip and be asserted, not just the length.
